items.q: Bisa menggunakan subdomain atau domain bisnis sendiri?
items.a: Akses toko menggunakan subdomain khusus yang disiapkan untuk bisnis Anda. Untuk domain bisnis sendiri, konfirmasikan ketersediaan dan kebutuhan pengaturannya bersama tim saat demo.

faq.title: Questions before you start
faq.subtitle: Start with the workflows that matter to your store.

items.a: BerkahEmas is gold-store software with inventory, POS, buyback and reporting workflows.

items.q: Can I try the ERP before subscribing?
items.a: Yes. Choose Try Free, enter your store name and email, verify your email, and set your password. The Trial package has Starter features and limits for 3 days after your store is ready, with no credit card required.

items.q: Can I use my store’s details on invoices?
items.a: The application includes invoice settings for your store’s details and uploaded logo.

items.q: Will it work with my existing devices?
items.a: Share the models of your scanner, printer and other devices. Confirm compatibility during the demo before choosing a plan.

items.q: Does each business have its own database?
items.a: Yes. BerkahEmas provisions a separate database for each business. Branches within the same business can be managed in one system.

items.q: Can I use a dedicated subdomain or my own business domain?
items.a: Your store uses a dedicated subdomain prepared for your business. For your own business domain, confirm availability and setup requirements with the team during a demo.

items.q: How do I buy a package after the trial?
items.a: Choose a package in Pricing to open WhatsApp with the package name included. Our team will help with payment and activation so you can continue with the same store.
